messages:
Jordan (sales): FYI pushing an exec sync for SolsticeHealth this morning — they surfaced three blockers: SSO constraints, logs/dataflow retention, and the final pricing ask. Need an internal status + exec-ready summary by 9:00 PT.
Priya S (AE): Can someone give me a one-paragraph summary I can send to their CIO? Also need exact committed qps / gpu ask for pricing.
Ethan M (eng-runtime): SSO: we support OIDC but their IdP requires signed JWT assertions with cert rotation every 7 days. That requires a small change in our onboarding playbook for private deploys. ETA to verify: 48-72h.
Claire R (solutions): Logs/dataflow: they need 13-month retention + continuous forward to Splunk with per-request audit IDs. Hosted product default is 90 days; Dedicated/private can meet 13 months. Need delta on pricing.
Ana (security): On the DPA/escrow side — they want an explicit key escrow clause and proof of SOC2 control mapping. Legal has a draft reply; I can push a version to counsel for signoff.
Alex (eng-ops): For private deployment we'll need their VPC CIDR, account IDs, and peering contacts. Typical lead time after we get CIDR: 24h for peering, 2–3 hours for install maintenance window. IPs we will use to allowlist: 34.203.12.45/32 and 34.203.12.46/32 (provisional).
Jordan (sales): Pricing ask: they want committed 1.2M tokens/mo + a dedicated 4-GPU pod, asking for 35% off list. What can we actually offer?
Priya S (AE): Need an econ note comparing committed vs burst pricing and the SLA delta for dedicated. @Ethan @Claire, can you provide numbers / guidance?
Ethan M (eng-runtime): Ballpark: 4x-A100-equivalent dedicated baseline + infra/ops => baseline $X/mo. With 1.2M tokens committed the unit cost goes down; I'll draft a concrete pricing delta by EOD. Note: HSM-backed KMS only on private deploys (legal/infra implication).
Claire R (solutions): Recommend we offer: 25% discount on committed usage, 1 month free onboarding, and an exec skip-level call. That usually closes these. If they insist on 35% we need an increased commit term.
Jordan (sales): Action: need an exec-ready doc by 9:00 PT. @Ana can you confirm DPA timeline? @Alex confirm peering lead time?
Ana (security): DPA + key-escrow item needs counsel signoff. Estimated 3 business days; can expedite to ~48h if sales secures exec-level email sign-off to prioritize.
Alex (eng-ops): Peering: once we have CIDR + account IDs we can provision in 24h. Private deploy package ready; will require a maintenance window and customer's approval.
Priya S (AE): I’ll draft the one-pager and the exec email. Jordan — can you tentatively block CIO time for 10:00 PT pending the doc?
Jordan (sales): Blocking calendar now: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/solstice-10am — holding until confirm.
deploy-bot: New run created: infra/peering-request-2071234567 — status: pending approval.
Ethan M (eng-runtime): Risk: if they require HSM-backed keys for hosted (not private), we need legal approval. That would force private-only path and may change timeline.
Ana (security): Also pulling SOC2 artifacts for their questionnaire Q9/Q12 — ETA EOD. Will post artifacts link here when ready.
Jordan (sales): Summarizing owners: 1) Priya = exec email + one-pager; 2) Alex = peering + CIDR follow-up; 3) Ana = DPA timeline + SOC2 artifacts; 4) Claire & Ethan = pricing/econ note.
Priya S (AE): Exec email draft (2-min read):
Priya S (AE): "Short summary: Redwood can deliver a private dedicated POC with 4-GPU capacity, 13-month logs retention, and enterprise SSO. Open items: DPA signature with key-escrow clause, VPC CIDR for peering, and final pricing. Ask: Exec intro + sign-off on a committed discount to proceed. We propose 25% off with a 6-month commitment; we can consider 35% with an extended 12-month commit."
Claire R (solutions): Posted pricing note: https://docs.internal/pricing/solstice-offer — includes cost breakdown and rationale.
Ethan M (eng-runtime): +1 to the email, add a short technical caveat: HSM only available on private installs.
Ana (security): +1 from security, will flag the DPA expedite if exec signs.
Alex (eng-ops): +1 from ops. Once we have CIDR we can start provisioning.
Jordan (sales): I'll send to their CIO at 09:05 PT unless any objections. If we get DPA signoff and CIDR confirmed we can target a 10/15 go-live for the POC. :thumbsup:
Priya S (AE): No objections. Thanks team, I'll post the final email in 5m.
